summary: Tested HSN/GST feature end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases passing for GET/PUT /api/admin/stock-items/hsn, GET /api/store/items enrichment, and POST /api/store/purchase-orders HSN-derived GST. Frontend: Admin HSN tab renders correctly with all required components (rows, inputs, category chips, bulk-assign, missing toggle, save button). Could not fully exercise the Raise PO modal UI for HSN warning/info testIDs in this run, but backend logic that drives that UI (gst_rate derivation) is verified working.

issues: 6 sub-tabs (Prices/Standards/History/Users/Numbering/HSN) fit on one row at 1920px width; may wrap on narrower/tablet viewports — acceptable.
Create button is labeled 'New PO', while problem statement & po-hsn-* testIDs imply a 'Raise PO' modal. Functionally equivalent, but label inconsistency vs review brief.

action_items: Optionally re-run a focused UI test clicking 'New PO' to open the modal and verify po-hsn-info-<idx>/po-hsn-warning-<idx> render + read-only GST field (label 'GST % (HSN xxxx)'). The backend already enforces HSN->GST override correctly (gst_rate=18 overriding client-sent 5 for HSN 8482 item; fallback to client-supplied gst_rate=12 when HSN missing — both verified).
Consider renaming 'New PO' button to 'Raise PO' to match spec terminology (cosmetic only).
critical_code_review_comments: admin.py: import of hsn_codes is placed inside the file body (line 1491) instead of at top — works but inconsistent with other imports; minor style issue.

inventory.py create_purchase_order correctly ignores client-supplied gst_rate when stock_item.hsn_code is present and falls back to client-supplied (or 18) when absent — clean single-source-of-truth pattern.
HSNBulkUpdate endpoint issues N individual update_one calls rather than a single bulk_write; fine for ~250 items but could be optimised if list grows.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (HSN admin UI verified; PO modal UI not opened due to button label mismatch)

seed_data_creation: Used existing data. Two PO rows created during backend test (client gst=5 overridden to 18 for HSN 8482 item; client gst=12 used for no-HSN item). No cleanup performed on POs (test-created purchase orders remain).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend HSN API is rock-solid. For UI: Raise-PO modal opens from Store > POs tab via '+ New PO' button (not 'Raise PO'). testIDs to verify inside: po-hsn-info-<idx> (green HSN confirmation), po-hsn-warning-<idx> (red 'HSN not set' warning), and the GST % TextInput must be editable=false with grey bg and label 'GST % (HSN xxxx)'. Admin HSN tab path: login as admin → bottom tab 'Admin' → sub-tab 'HSN' (testID hsn-tab). 251 stock items, 1 already with HSN (bearing id 69e234e976aa33f380f53d20 → 8482 → 18%).
rca of the issue: No bugs found in scope. Feature implementation matches the spec: single-source-of-truth GST via HSN lookup, admin-only endpoints with 403 for non-admins, bulk edit persisting via Mongo update_one per id, frontend admin tab renders and drives the backend endpoints.
